node.statement: Nodes 1.4.3.1 and 1.4.3.2 are two expansions of the same vector p_{u_r} in the ordered basis p_{u_0}, p_{u_1}, p_{u_2}. By the uniqueness statement in node 1.4.1, the coefficient tuples must be equal coordinatewise. Therefore, for every q in {0,1,2}, sum_i beta_r(i)*a_q(i) = delta_{q r}.
